Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a a number of countries where we cannot have Zapier teammates based. Additionally, because Zapier is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas or transfers. Zapier teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

That said, while Al can be a helpful assistant, your application should still reflect you. You have the opportunity to stand out by being specific, reflective and thoughtful about your own real experiences.

We value transparency and trust — and that starts from day one. We expect you to complete live interviews on your own. In our skills assessments, Al tools may be encouraged — we'll be interested in how you use them.

If we find that you have misrepresented yourself at any stage of the process, we'll remove you from consideration for this and future roles at Zapier.

Zapier Demographic Questions

Zapier strives to be a workplace where diversity, inclusion, belonging, and equity are part of our DNA. In this effort, we invite candidates to share demographic information to help us measure and improve representation. We anonymize this information and use it in aggregate to assess diversity across all stages of the recruiting process. However, your personally identifiable information will not be visible to your hiring manager or recruiter (now or if you are hired). Additionally, your responses will not be evaluated as part of your candidacy or any future employment decisions. Lastly, submitting this is completely voluntary.
